failurePattern: HTTP 402 response is missing PAYMENT-REQUIRED
fix: Set the HTTP header `PAYMENT-REQUIRED: <base64-json>` with a valid x402 v2 payment challenge payload.
source: x402 Spec v2.0 - Section 3 (Payment Challenge Headers)

failurePattern: Challenge is not valid base64
fix: Encode the x402 challenge object into standard Base64 or Base64URL without whitespace: `Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(challenge)).toString('base64')`.
source: x402 Spec v2.0 - Section 3.2 (Encoding Standards)

failurePattern: Decoded challenge is not valid JSON
fix: Ensure the payload decoded from PAYMENT-REQUIRED parses as valid JSON: `JSON.parse(decoded)`.
source: x402 Spec v2.0 - Section 4 (Challenge Object Schema)

failurePattern: Challenge must declare x402Version 2
fix: Specify `"x402Version": 2` at the root of the challenge JSON object.
source: x402 Protocol Specification - Migration Guide v1 to v2

failurePattern: Resource metadata is incomplete
fix: Define `resource: { url: 'https://...', description: '...', mimeType: 'application/json' }` containing valid HTTPS endpoint details.
source: A2MCP Agent Discovery Standard - Resource Definition

failurePattern: Resource URL does not match the audited host
fix: Ensure `resource.url` matches the publicly reachable origin/hostname of the audited agent endpoint.
source: A2MCP Security Architecture - Origin Matching Invariants

failurePattern: accepts must be a non-empty array
fix: Supply at least one payment option in the `accepts` array declaring scheme, network, asset, and payTo address.
source: x402 Spec v2.0 - Payment Options Array

failurePattern: Payment option does not target X Layer
fix: Specify `"network": "eip155:196"` to target the OKX X Layer mainnet.
source: X Layer Developer Documentation - CAIP-2 Network Identifiers

failurePattern: Asset address is missing or malformed
fix: Provide `asset` as a 42-character 0x-prefixed hex ERC-20 contract address (e.g., `0x...` with 40 hex chars).
source: ERC-20 Token Specification & EVM Address Validation

failurePattern: Recipient address is missing or malformed
fix: Provide `payTo` as a valid 42-character 0x-prefixed hex recipient address.
source: EVM Address Standards & Payment Settlement Rules

failurePattern: Unexpected HTTP status
fix: Configure the agent route to return HTTP 200 with JSON for free services, or HTTP 402 with PAYMENT-REQUIRED for paid tiers.
source: RFC 9110 HTTP Semantics - Status Codes

failurePattern: Response omitted Content-Type or not application/json
fix: Return `Content-Type: application/json` in the response headers.
source: A2MCP Transport Protocol - MIME Typing

failurePattern: Response body is not valid JSON
fix: Serialize response body strictly via JSON format (`JSON.stringify()`) avoiding raw text or trailing commas.
source: RFC 8259 The JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) Data Interchange Format

failurePattern: Reduce endpoint latency; under 1.5 seconds is preferred
fix: Optimize cold starts, database queries, and upstream LLM calls so latency stays well below 1500ms.
source: Preflight Agent Reliability Best Practices

failurePattern: Followed validated redirect(s)
fix: Configure the direct canonical HTTPS URL avoiding 301/302/307/308 redirect hops.
source: Preflight Transport Optimization Guidelines

failurePattern: Response exceeded the 256 KB limit
fix: Trim payloads, paginate large item lists, or compress bulky records to remain below the 256 KB limit.
source: Agent Service Provider Bounded Buffer Constraints

failurePattern: Target hostname resolves to a private, local, or reserved address
fix: Deploy your service on a public internet IP; private ranges (RFC 1918, RFC 3927, loopback) are rejected for SSRF safety.
source: OWASP SSRF Prevention Cheat Sheet

failurePattern: Scheme is not HTTPS
fix: Serve your service through HTTPS with a valid TLS certificate; unencrypted HTTP is strictly disallowed.
source: Transport Layer Security & Agent Economy Trust Requirements

failurePattern: Credentials in target URLs are not allowed
fix: Remove embedded basic auth credentials (`user:pass@`) from the target URL.
source: RFC 3986 Uniform Resource Identifier (URI): Generic Syntax

failurePattern: Request timed out after 5 seconds
fix: Ensure your server completes handshake and initiates response headers within the 5000ms SLA.
source: Preflight Service Level Agreement & Timeout Policy

failurePattern: maxTimeoutSeconds missing or invalid
fix: Declare `maxTimeoutSeconds: 300` within payment option to protect client funds against hanging quotes.
source: x402 Spec v2.0 - Payment Authorization Deadlines

failurePattern: amount is missing or not a numeric string
fix: Specify `amount` as an atomic integer string (e.g. `"10000"` representing micro-units) without floating point decimals.
source: x402 Spec v2.0 - Numeric Representation of Value

failurePattern: scheme is not exact
fix: Set `"scheme": "exact"` in the payment option for single-settlement invocation guarantees.
source: x402 Spec v2.0 - Settlement Schemes

failurePattern: Could not safely resolve the target hostname
fix: Verify domain DNS records (A/AAAA) have propagated to public DNS resolvers (e.g. 1.1.1.1).
source: DNS Standards & Public Resolver Hygiene

failurePattern: Target exceeded the 3-redirect limit
fix: Eliminate circular or multi-hop redirect chains and expose the final termination URL directly.
source: Preflight Transport Limits
